heading: Every code
body:
Codes that start with `TY1` come from `ty` before your app runs. Codes that start with `TY2` come from the server or from the runtime of a language. Some codes cover several problems; the message says which one. The last column names the guide that explains the code, as topic / section, or a feature page.

Finding the project and its routes (`TY1001` to `TY1010`):

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TY1001` | `ty` cannot open the project folder, or a command got a wrong `--target`: a name that is not `web`, `macos`, `windows`, `linux`, `android`, `ios` or `all`, more than one target where the command takes one, or `web` where the command needs a native target. The removed `--render-mode` option and `TAC_RENDER_MODE` variable also stop here. | Targets / Targets |
| `TY1002` | The build found no page, no controller and no component in `tac.elements`. Add a `client/pages/tac.html` view, a controller in `server/controllers/`, or an exported element. | Components in other apps / Export a component |
| `TY1003` | Two views claim the same URL, or two controller methods answer the same HTTP method and path. Keep one view for each URL and one method for each route. | Pages and URLs / Folders become URLs; Controllers / Route rules |
| `TY1004` | A project file or folder is a symbolic link, or a source path leads out of its folder. Replace the link with a real file or folder. | Project folders and roles / Where each file goes |
| `TY1005` | A page folder name is not a valid part of a URL. Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens inside the name. A source path that is not valid Unicode also stops here. | Pages and URLs / Folders become URLs |
| `TY1006` | A dynamic page folder, such as `_id`, has a name that is not lowercase letters, digits and underscores, or one URL uses the same dynamic name twice. | Pages and URLs / Folders become URLs |
| `TY1008` | The project has a `yon.html` file. Yon answers with data, and it never renders HTML; return HTML with `Content-Type: text/html` from a controller instead. It also stops a `tac.*` file beside a view with an extension that Tachyon does not read. | Models and JSON answers / How return values become responses |
| `TY1009` | A compiler for a service failed, and the message shows its output. For a Dart service it is `dart compile wasm` from the Dart SDK 3.13 or newer on `PATH`. For a TypeScript file it is the TypeScript compiler, version 6 or newer, as a project dependency or on `PATH`. | WebAssembly compilers per language / Which compiler each language uses |
| `TY1010` | A native app has more than 128 native services. | Rust, Go and C# in the browser / Services are compiled in |

Writing the build output (`TY1201` and `TY1202`):

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TY1201` | `ty` cannot write the build output: the output folder has no parent that it can write, a file cannot be published, `client/manifest.json` is not a regular file of at most 1 MiB, or `ty api freeze` cannot write `server/api-baseline.json`. Check the folder permissions, and that no other program holds the output. | Build and deploy / Build and deploy |
| `TY1202` | The output folder is a symbolic link, passes through one, is not a folder, or is in a place that is not safe. Use a normal folder outside `client/`, `server/` and `.git/`. | Build and deploy / Build and deploy |

Checking views, classes and the server (`TY1301` to `TY1372`):

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TY1301` | A view cannot be read as HTML: the file is empty, larger than 1 MiB, not UTF-8 or holds a NUL byte, an element is not closed or closes in the wrong order, elements nest deeper than 64 levels, or an element that takes no content has some. `ty preview`, `ty serve` and `ty start` also stop with it when you ask for an address outside your computer without `--allow-non-loopback`. | Templates / Values in braces and events; Preview and build / When the project has a problem |
| `TY1302` | The server cannot listen: the port is in use, the port or the address is not valid, or a host name is not `localhost` or a name under `.localhost`. In a view, it also stops a `<logic :else-if>` or `<logic else>` without a branch right before it, a control element used in a wrong way, and a slot name that is not fixed text. | Preview and build / Run on a name under .localhost; Templates / Control flow |
| `TY1303` | The server stopped while it ran, and the message gives the reason. One cause is the topic log folder: `topics.directory` has `..`, is inside `.tachyon`, passes through a symbolic link, or cannot be opened or created. In a view, the same code stops text where `{` has no closing `}`, or an expression that is not a simple path, literal, comparison or boolean operator. | Topics / Topics; Templates / Values in braces and events |
| `TY1304` | `ty preview` got a bundle folder that does not exist (run `ty bundle` first), or a view has a dynamic attribute whose name is not valid. | Preview and build / One program for pages and server |
| `TY1305` | A view is too big for the browser: once compiled, its plan is larger than 10 MiB or has more than 100,000 nodes. Split it into smaller components. `ty preview` also uses this code when it cannot watch the project files; then check the folder permissions or use `--no-watch`. | Templates / Components |
| `TY1306` | A view or a service uses a form that Tac no longer reads: a native event attribute such as `onclick` (write `on:click`), raw HTML in braces, a field with the old `$` or `$$` prefix (write `@SessionState` or `@LocalState`), the retired lifecycle and signal decorators, or a page state script that holds more than literal values. `ty migrate fix --write` converts the old fields. | Templates / Values in braces and events; Saving data in the browser / Saved service fields |
| `TY1307` | A view contains a doctype, `<html>`, `<head>` or `<body>`. Tachyon writes these parts itself. | Templates / Values in braces and events; Feature: A view is not a document |
| `TY1308` | A realm or a language does not accept this annotation, or the annotation has a new name, such as `@Component`, which is now `@Helper`. It also stops an `HTTPClient` that is not a contract: a class where the language has an interface, trait, protocol or `Protocol` form, a method body, a field, a constructor, a method without a request annotation, or a client that is also a service. It stops a `Store` the same way, and also a Store without an Entity or a method that is not a query: a Store is a contract, so an `AllOrNothing` method on a Store is refused too. The transaction goes on the service method that calls the store, and the store's queries join it. A Store may extend `Repository<Entity, Id>`; the code also stops that base on a type that is not a Store, or a Repository that names another Entity than its Store. It stops a `Converter` the same way: a method body, a field, a constructor or a method without `Convert` ("A Converter has no implementation: Tachyon generates each mapping."). `ty migrate fix --write` rewrites a class client, store or converter. A Lua Tac service refuses behavior annotations such as `Cached`, `Retry` and `AllOrNothing`, `HTTPClient`, `Store`, `LocalState`, `SessionState`, `Topic`, `Helper` and `Fake` (ADR 0085). | Annotations A–Z / What each realm refuses |
| `TY1309` | A page holds something other than component tags. A page's `tac.html` holds only component tags, white space and comments, and a page folder holds only `tac.html`, with no CSS or other file. Move markup, text and styles into a component in `client/components/` and place its tag in the page. | Feature: Components and slots; Feature: Styles next to each view |
| `TY1310` | A role file breaks the folder or file-name rules, or sits in a folder with a new name, such as `delegates`, which is now `helpers`, or `client/utils`, which is now `client/shared/utils`. It also reports a broken native Go module in `server/packages/`: no `go.mod`, a `go.mod` without a module line or with a line other than `module`, `go`, `toolchain` and `require`, a second `go.mod`, a package in the reserved `yonhandler/` folder, an annotation, or another language's source file (ADR 0095). | Project folders and roles / Strict role folders and file names |
| `TY1311` | A view reads a file in `client/shared/data` that does not exist, or reads a member of a Go service in a case that the service does not expose, such as `settings.oauthNotice` when the Go field `OAuthNotice` reaches views as `oAuthNotice`. The message names the member to write. | Templates / Shared data and the page; Polyglot / Rust, Go and C# on the web |
| `TY1312` | A `Gateway` is wrong. The class that it calls is missing, is outside `server/`, is not written in a Yon language, is in the language of the caller, or declares a gateway itself (only one hop is allowed). The method is missing, is not an instance method, takes another number of arguments, or has two JSON forms with the same number of arguments. A gateway also goes only on a service method, never on a route, takes at most 32 arguments, and is not a Tac annotation. | Relays and gateways / Calling a method in another language |
| `TY1313` | A plain attribute has a value in braces, such as `title="{name}"`. Braces work only in text. Write `:title="name"` instead. | Templates / Values in braces and events |
| `TY1314` | A public method of a service or a controller holds a decision, a loop or `try`, or a private method holds more than one decision or loop. Move the code into private methods. | Cohesive services / Public methods coordinate |
| `TY1315` | A block of code repeats: at least 100 tokens over 10 lines, even with other names or values. Move it into a static method of a utility class. | Utilities / One place for repeated code |
| `TY1316` | A utility class holds a field, a stored value or a method that is not static. | Utilities / One place for repeated code |
| `TY1317` | Tac code in Rust, Go, C#, F#, Swift, Kotlin, Java, Dart or Ruby calls the browser directly, for example with Go's `syscall/js`, Swift's `JavaScriptKit` or TeaVM's `@JSBody` in Java. The code also stops a service that is linked into a native app when it uses one of Tachyon's browser APIs or built-in event models, such as `Clipboard` or `ConnectivityChanged`. Put the browser work in a JavaScript, TypeScript or WebAssembly service and send the result with an event. | Rust, Go and C# in the browser / What each service language can use in the browser |
| `TY1318` | A class file does not have the name of its class, for example `Order.ts` that declares `Invoice`, or a models file holds more than one model. Rename the file or the class so that both have the same spelling, and put each model in its own file. | Project folders and roles / File names follow the class |
| `TY1320` | `ty` changed on disk. The preview restarts with the new `ty`, or keeps the old server when the new `ty` refuses the project, and says why. | Preview and build / When the project has a problem |
| `TY1321` | `ty preview` or `ty serve` found a new `ty` on disk but could not start it. The message gives the reason. Start the command again by hand. | Preview and build / When the project has a problem |
| `TY1322` | A route does not say who may call it, or `@Allow` names a role that has no type in `server/roles/`. Write `@Public`, `@SignedIn` or `@Allow(Role)`. | Who may call a route / Every route says who may call it |
| `TY1323` | A `@SignedIn` or `@Allow` route has no `@IdentityProvider` class to say who is signed in, or the project has two of them. | Who may call a route / Tell Tachyon who is signed in |
| `TY1324` | The code, a template or public settings hold what looks like a password, a token or a key. Put it in `.env` with a `YON_` name. | Settings and configuration / Configuration and secrets are separate |
| `TY1325` | Code runs a text as code (`eval` and similar calls), or joins values into query text instead of passing them as parameters. | Isolation and security / Security rules for browser code |
| `TY1326` | Code sends a request to a host that `tac.outgoing.hosts` or `outgoing.hosts` does not list. | Isolation and security / Security rules for browser code |
| `TY1327` | Classes need each other in a loop, a class needs a class of a higher layer, a class needs a controller, or a utility class names a role class such as a service. The message names the whole loop. | Dependencies point down / Dependencies point down |
| `TY1328` | A class, method, field or parameter name has a word that is not English, such as `usr` or `cfg`. The help gives the whole word. | Plain-English names / Names are whole English words |
| `TY1329` | A method takes more than 4 parameters, or a class needs more than 5 other classes. | Small signatures / Few parameters and few dependencies |
| `TY1330` | A text or number is written twice or more in a class, or a number is in a condition, without a name. Give it a class constant; the help shows one in the language of the file, such as `static let` in F#. | Named values / Give values a name |
| `TY1331` | A field that Tachyon fills, a `Needs` field or a `NeedsAll` field without a starting value, is declared nullable, for example `label?: string` or `final String? path;`. Tachyon never leaves it null. Write the non-null form, such as `label!: string` or `late final String path;`, or give a field that may stay empty a starting value. `ty migrate fix --write` rewrites the simple cases. | Dependency injection / Fields that Needs fills |
| `TY1332` | A field that holds an injected class, a `Needs` field or a Yon `NeedsAll` field, does not use the language's variable case, for example `LedgerStore LedgerStore;` in Java or `ledgerStore: LedgerStore` in Python. Write lowerCamel case (`ledgerStore`) in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Groovy, Kotlin, Swift, Dart, Go and PHP (`$ledgerStore`). Write snake_case (`ledger_store`) in Python, Ruby and Rust. A private or internal C# field uses an underscore with lowerCamel case (`_ledgerStore`), and a C# property or public field uses `LedgerStore`. Only the case is checked, not the words. `ty migrate fix --write` renames the field and its uses in the class. | Dependency injection / Fields that Needs fills |
| `TY1333` | A public method or field of a service, helper, controller or utility is used by nothing outside its class: no view, no other class and no annotation. Make it private in the form of your language. | Public only when used / Public only when used |
| `TY1334` | A Groovy field or method is declared with `def`. Tachyon reads member types to check routes, models and injection. Write the type, such as `String name` or `List<Order> findOrders()`. A local variable inside a method may still use `def`. | Types in every language / Every member states its type |
| `TY1335` | An F# file has a `module` or `namespace` line, a file-level `let` or `do`, or an attribute on the same line as the type or member it marks. Tachyon places every F# file in one namespace, and each attribute goes on its own line. | The Yon languages / Languages Yon runs |
| `TY1336` | A view is hard to use with a screen reader or a keyboard: a picture without `alt`, a button, link or field without a name or label, a skipped heading level, a `tabindex` above 0, a wrong `aria-*` attribute, or an `<iframe>` without a title. | Templates / Accessible views |
| `TY1337` | A route loads more script or WebAssembly than `tac.budgets.script` or `tac.budgets.webassembly` allows. The message names the biggest files, and on a route with several web runtimes it also names the computed budget and the runtimes it counted. | Build and deploy / Route size budgets |
| `TY1338` | The API breaks `server/api-baseline.json`: a route, method, model or field is gone, a type is narrower, a value became required, or the status changed, and the major version did not go up. | Build and deploy / Keep the API that callers use |
| `TY1339` | A test case (a `test` method of a `Test` class) has no assertion, or it holds a branch or a loop: `if`, `else`, a loop, `switch`, `match`, `when` or `? :`. Check the result with `Assert.equals`, `Assert.isTrue`, `Assert.throws` (`Assert.throwsError` in Java and Groovy, `Assert.Equals` in Go) or the assert of your language, and list inputs in `ValueSource` instead of a loop. Turn it off with `tests.check: false` / `tac.tests.check: false`. | Test units / Assert and ValueSource |
| `TY1340`–`TY1355` | A suggestion, not an error: the code has a simpler form that reads more plainly, such as `return a > b;` instead of an `if` that returns `true` or `false`. The build goes on. `ty migrate fix --write` applies the simpler form. | Simpler forms / Every simpler form |
| `TY1356` | A field, parameter or return value of a class has no type, or a JavaScript field has no starting value and Tachyon does not fill it. The code also stops a Ruby type comment that names no known class, and a class file that switches the type checker off (`@ts-nocheck`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, `# type: ignore`). Write the type comment or native type that the help shows. The check is off until you set `types.check` or `tac.types.check` to `true`. | Types in every language / Every member states its type |
| `TY1357` | A Lua class file holds something Tachyon cannot read: `local Name = {}`, `return Name`, `require`, a second class table, a method of another table, a method on one line, or code outside a method. Tachyon joins the Lua class files of one realm, so each file holds one global table, its constants and its `function Name:method(...)` methods. | The Yon languages / Languages Yon runs |
| `TY1358` | `tac.elements` in `client/manifest.json` names something that cannot be a custom element: a name without a hyphen, or a name that is not a component. | Components in other apps / Export a component |
| `TY1360` | A JavaScript or TypeScript Tac service reads `globalThis`, for example the old `globalThis.tachyonWindow`. A service gets the browser by injection: `@Needs windowControls` for the window, and each other browser API from its own `@Needs` field. | Window controls / Window controls need permission |
| `TY1361` | A JavaScript or TypeScript Tac service calls `fetch` itself. The network belongs to an `HTTPClient`: move the request into a request method such as `@GetRequest`, inject the client with `@Needs`, and mark a public read `Cached` so the service worker may answer it. | Calling the server from a page / Client classes that call the server |
| `TY1362` | Optional suggestion: an owned Java, Kotlin, C#, Groovy, Swift or Dart method can access a declared member by its bare name. The suggestion preserves uncertain name binding and nested scopes. Enable tac.implicitmembers.suggest or implicitmembers.suggest; both default to false. | Simpler forms / Suggestions, not errors |
| `TY1363` | A class in a role folder has no role marker, for example a class in `client/services/` without `@Service`, or a class in `server/controllers/` without `@RequestRoute`, `@SocketRoute`, `@ErrorHandler` or `@IdentityProvider`. The folder does not register a class. Add the marker if the class really has that role; otherwise move it to `models/`, `shared/` or a utility folder. `ty migrate check` lists each missing marker. | Project folders and roles / One structure check before the build |
| `TY1364` | A client script builds component markup or writes component styles: `innerHTML` or `outerHTML` (also with `??=`, `+=` and the other compound forms), `document.write`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `setHTML` or `setHTMLUnsafe`, inserting nodes made with `document.createElement` (`append`, `appendChild`, ...), `element.style` and its fields, `setAttribute('style', ...)` or a style sheet. The check follows aliases, fields of objects such as `refs.list`, `bind`, `call` and `apply`. It is a build-time convention check, not a sandbox. Put markup in the component's `tac.html` and styles in its `tac.css`; a script changes text, classes and service state. | Templates / Markup and styles stay in the view |
| `TY1365` | A third-party script in `tac.scriptSources` is declared wrongly: it is not in `client/shared/`, it is in a utility folder, it is missing from `tac.scripts`, or the file does not exist. Keep the file in `client/shared/` and list it in both settings. A file whose bytes do not match its pinned SHA-256 fails with `TY1403`. | Templates / Markup and styles stay in the view; Settings and configuration / client/manifest.json, field by field |
| `TY1366` | A server on a loopback address refused a request (`403`) whose `Host` name is not `localhost` or a name under `.localhost`, not an IP address, not the host of `tac.origin` and not listed in `server.hosts` in `server/application.json`. This stops DNS rebinding. Add the name that your tunnel or reverse proxy sends to `server.hosts`. | Isolation and security / Host names and local addresses |
| `TY1367` | A view uses an `<if>`, `<else>` or `<for>` element. These were removed: write `<logic :if="ready">`, `<logic else>` or `<loop :for="item of items">`. `ty migrate fix --write` rewrites them for you. | Templates / Control flow |
| `TY1368` | `server/packages/go.mod` requires a third-party Go module that is not vendored: `go.sum` or `vendor/modules.txt` is missing, `vendor/` no longer matches `go.mod`, or Go code imports a module that `vendor/` does not hold. Tachyon builds Go offline and never downloads modules: run `go mod vendor` in `server/packages/` and commit `go.sum` and `vendor/` (ADR 0095). | Modules and lifecycle / Vendored Go modules |
| `TY1369` | A JavaScript, TypeScript or Dart file imports a file of the other realm with a relative path, for example a client service that imports `../../server/controllers/HomeController.js`. Tac (client) code runs in the browser and Yon (server) code runs on the server, so neither imports the other. Call the server through an HTTPClient in `client/remotes`, and give each realm its own model, utility or service. The check runs before the build writes output or starts a compiler, and `ty migrate check` lists each such import. | Project folders and roles / One structure check before the build |
| `TY1370` | A native menu action in `tac.application.menus` names something that cannot run it: a service that is not a client Rust service with `#[Lifetime({"value":"application"})]`, a method that does not exist or takes more than `&self`, or an `event` that is not a Rust model in `client/models`. | Native menus / Menu actions |
| `TY1371` | A C++ class file holds something Tachyon cannot read: a Tachyon marker spelled in lowercase (`[[service]]`), with a namespace (`[[tachyon::Service]]`) or unknown (`[[Servise]]`, with the closest marker as a hint), a class marker before `class` instead of after it, a second class, a namespace, a template, a free function, a class not named after its file, a nested type in a service, a `[[Needs]]` field that is not a reference without a value, overloaded page methods, or an `[[HTTPClient]]` method without exactly one request marker and a `Task<...>` answer. Write one header-only class per `.hpp` file with `class [[Service]] Name` (ADR 0099). | Project folders and roles / Tac: every service language |
| `TY1372` | A C++ class uses a part of C++ support that comes later: a `[[Needs]]` field names a type that is neither a C++ service in `client/services` nor a C++ HTTP client in `client/remotes`, or a C++ model is outside `client/models`, because Yon does not run C++ yet (ADR 0099). | Project folders and roles / Tac: every service language |

Components, project setup and tools (`TY1401` to `TY1410`):

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TY1401` | A component folder is wrong: the components folder cannot be read or is not a real folder, a component is a symbolic link, its folder name is a standard HTML tag or holds a script, it has a `tac.css` without `tac.html`, or the app has more than 1,024 components. `ty init` also uses this code when it cannot create the project folder. | Templates / Components; Install / Choose what ty init creates |
| `TY1402` | A view uses a component tag that no folder in `client/components/` defines, or `ty init` or `ty add` would write over a file or into a folder that is not empty. Tachyon never overwrites your files. | Templates / Components; Install / Choose what ty init creates |
| `TY1403` | A style or a vendor file is not accepted: a component's HTML holds `<style>` or a style sheet link, a `tac.css` cannot be scoped or is larger than 1 MiB, a global style sheet is not foundation CSS (colors, fonts and resets) or is not declared in `tac.styleSources`, a pinned vendor file does not match its SHA-256, or components use each other in a loop. `ty init` also uses this code for an application name that is not 1 to 100 printable characters. | Templates / Markup and styles stay in the view |
| `TY1404` | A component received children that it cannot show: children without a `slot` attribute when it has no `<slot>`, or a child for a named slot that it does not declare, such as `slot="footer"` without `<slot name="footer">`. It also stops a `hydrate` value that is not fixed text or not one of `load`, `idle`, `visible`, `interaction` and `never`, and `hydrate` on a tag that is not a component. | Templates / Components; Templates / When a component starts |
| `TY1405` | A component has a `hydrate` value, but its view names no service. Remove `hydrate`, or use a service. The same code stops the build when a member of a compiled service cannot reach the page. Examples are a Java web service field of type `char`, a Java listener that does not take one model, a Java web service that uses an annotation other than `OnStart`, `OnStop`, `OnEvent`, `Order`, `InBackground`, `LocalState`, `SessionState`, `Needs` and the behavior annotations, or an F# Tac service whose primary constructor takes a collaborator or a behavior runtime type, or takes properties without `[<NeedsAll>]`. It also stops an `async` event or lifecycle method of a Rust, Swift, Kotlin or C# service that is linked into a native app: these methods must be synchronous. The message names what works. | Annotations A–Z / What each realm refuses; Templates / When a component starts |
| `TY1406` | A Rust, Swift, Kotlin or C# service file does not declare the type it is named after, a Rust service struct has no `fn new() -> Self` or `Default`, or the service exposes nothing the page can read. A field or method that uses text, numbers, lists or models from `client/models` (a list of models and nested models too) reaches the page. A member that takes or holds a behavior runtime type such as `BehaviorValue` stays inside the service. It also stops a service with `Lifetime({"value":"application"})` in a build that cannot own it: the browser, iOS or Android. Only native macOS, Linux and Windows builds with Rust can. A native Rust lifecycle method must be synchronous and take no arguments. It also stops a Go `Needs` field that names another Go service when the field holds the service by value instead of a pointer, when that service has one instance for each component (`Lifetime` prototype or `NeedsAll`), when Go services need each other in a circle, or when the page has the service under two instance names and the field name is neither. | Dependency injection / Injection: Tac; Dependency injection / A service that needs another service: Tac; Native menus / Menu actions |
| `TY1407` | A page does not pass a property that a `NeedsAll` service needs, or it passes a property to a field that the service gets injected instead, such as `documentation` next to `DocumentationService`. Rename the field, or stop passing the property. A `FilePicker` field in a Go, Java, Ruby, Python or F# service is such a property, because those languages have no file picker provider yet. | Dependency injection / Injection: Tac; Services / One per page, or one per component |
| `TY1408` | An answer to `ty init` or `ty add` is not in the list, or two answers do not fit together, for example a sockets example in an app without a server. | Install / Choose what ty init creates |
| `TY1409` | A tool install did not finish, or a download does not match the SHA-256 that its vendor publishes or that Tachyon pins (emsdk, TinyGo, TeaVM). Tachyon deletes such a download. | Install / Install |
| `TY1410` | `ty` cannot write the composed types in `.tachyon/types`, or two composed service or model types have the same name across languages. Keep `.tachyon/types` a normal folder in the project, not a symbolic link, and give each type its own name. | Behavior annotations / Saved data, outgoing calls and types |

Workers and the cache (`TY1502` and `TY1503`):

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TY1502` | A worker says how often it runs in two places, a `Schedule` marker and a `.tachyonrc` interval. Use only one. It also stops a schedule with the wrong shape, such as a Lua `-- @Schedule` line that Tachyon cannot read. | Annotations A–Z / Scheduling: Yon |
| `TY1503` | `ty cache` cannot read or clear the Tachyon cache. Check the folder permissions, or set `TAC_CACHE_DIR` to a folder that you can write. | Build and deploy / Compressed files |

Settings, native builds and Python (`TY1601` and `TY1605`):

| Code | What it means | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TY1601` | A setting in the `tac` member of `client/manifest.json` is not valid, and the message names it. Examples are a browser API listed twice in `tac.browserApis`, a cache path or sitemap entry with the wrong shape, a `tac.python` that does not select the pinned runtime, and a `start_url` that is not a page.
